TS046 allocation-grouping

An allocation and the defer that releases it sit together, set off by blank lines, so a missing defer is visible.

languages: go odin zig
severity: info
default: opt-in
group: stable
javascript: JavaScript frees by garbage collection rather than at a defer, so the paired-allocation shape has no syntax to anchor on
python: Python frees by refcount rather than at a defer, so the paired-allocation shape has no syntax to anchor on
rust: Rust frees on drop rather than at a defer, so the paired-allocation shape this rule looks for has no syntax to anchor on
typescript: TypeScript frees by garbage collection rather than at a defer, so the paired-allocation shape has no syntax to anchor on

TigerStyle: "Use newlines to **group resource allocation and deallocation**, i.e. before the resource allocation and after the corresponding `defer` statement, to make leaks easier to spot."
